srList.sentence: Signal attenuation ratio The signal attenuation ratio was calculated as the signal intensity of the image obtained in the presence of the titanium mesh divided by the signal intensity obtained in the absence of the mesh on assessing these images directly using ImageJ ( Version 1.52a; National Institute of Health , Bethesda , MD , USA) .

srList.sentence: Statistical analysis The Friedman test, Steel–Dwass multiple comparison test (for NAAD of four sequences in Table 1 and FA dependency in SE), and Wilcoxon signed-rank test (for NAAD of the area of excitation dependency) were used for statistical analyses (EZR Version 1.4.2; Jichi Medical University Saitama Medical Center, Saitama, Japan). 22 A P-value <0.05 was considered statistically significant.
